Historical: original controller on five real tasks, five rounds, seed 42, against fixed rank 32 -- rank 2 throughout, 93.75% FLOP savings, zero capability violations, accuracy gate failed on three tasks (preserved). Revised: two-round warm-up at each client's feasible maximum rank, half-capability minimum rank, relative quality-drop safeguard restoring the feasible maximum; capability-matched fixed baseline [4, 8, 16]. Fashion-MNIST, 5 rounds, seed 42 on gpu003: matched 82.85%, adaptive 82.85%, FLOPs 26.64144B vs 23.977296B (10.0% reduction), transient round-4 dip. Five-task parity unproven.

Bounded domain-aware factors from standardized domain signals; default blend strength 0.10; factors clipped to [0.85, 1.15] and normalized under base sample-times-quality weights. Model-free contribution-ranking improvement only; no end-to-end accuracy or privacy claim.

evidence_rules.primary_endpoint: Final communication round; never select the best seed or round silently
evidence_rules.display_accuracy: Multiply by 100 for percent; accuracy differences are percentage points
evidence_rules.seed_aggregation: Report individual seeds, arithmetic mean and sample standard deviation
evidence_rules.smoke_tests: Single-seed or short runs validate execution, not scientific conclusions
evidence_rules.historical_p3_results: Experiments 01-03 are two-round smoke tests from an older protocol and are not directly comparable
evidence_rules.historical_p2_results: Stale-marked outputs must not be cited as regenerated real-data results
evidence_rules.compression: mean_residual_energy is absolute squared error; mean_tail_mass is relative squared error
evidence_rules.communication: Keep effective-matrix and operational staged accounting separate; preserve payload dtype and representation
evidence_rules.privacy: No privacy guarantee follows from decentralized communication or adapter-only sharing
evidence_rules.oracle: Known domain assignments are inputs, not a successful domain-discovery result
evidence_rules.feasible_baseline: Compare adaptive rank against a capability-matched fixed baseline (ranks within each client's maximum). The fixed rank-32 reference is infeasible for every client and is a compute reference only; label it as such wherever it appears.
evidence_rules.test_machine: gpu003 is the required test and experiment machine. Local tests do not replace SSH validation.
evidence_rules.historical_results: Superseded results are preserved and labeled historical; they are never deleted or silently overwritten.

statements: The project's original end-to-end goal is not yet achieved.
Adaptive rank reaches final-accuracy parity with a feasible capability-matched baseline on one Fashion-MNIST experiment (seed 42, 5 rounds, 10.0% FLOP saving); broader five-task parity is unproven.
Conservative domain weighting improves model-free contribution ranking modestly (Spearman 0.152 to 0.196; pairwise accuracy 0.520 to 0.547); end-to-end accuracy improvement is unproven.
No privacy guarantee has been demonstrated.
Low-rank adapters and decentralized exchange alone do not establish privacy.
Privacy claims require separate differential-privacy, membership-inference, reconstruction, or secure-aggregation experiments; none has been run.

completion_statement: All requested implementation components, experiments, tests, artifacts, PR reviews, merges, and paper updates are complete. Results that do not meet the original performance or privacy objective are recorded as negative findings.
